articles.summary: Cloudflare OS gives everyone in your organization an agent workspace that knows how your company works and connects to its data and systems. We’re opening the waitlist for fully managed deployments that you’ll be able to launch in a few clicks.
articles.title: Cloudflare OS: your company’s agent workspace, managed for you

articles.summary: We redesigned Cloudflare Radar to make real-time global traffic and outage data accessible to a wider audience — including journalists, less technical researchers, and everyday users. By introducing an interactive map and standardized components, we simplified navigation while preserving technical depth.
articles.title: Bridging technical depth and usability: The story behind Radar’s redesign

articles.summary: We are introducing Clef and Clef-flash, open-source decision models hosted on Workers AI for high-speed classification and agentic workflows. Also launching: a new reinforcement learning platform that allows developers to fine-tune decision models using their own data.
articles.title: Introducing Clef: our open-source decision models, and new RL fine-tuning platform

articles.summary: A year after announcing our goal to hire 1,111 interns, more than 750 early-career builders have shipped real products across 48 teams at Cloudflare. From Birthday Week launches to post-quantum security, our interns prove that AI amplifies human potential, rather than replacing it.
articles.title: One year later: the power of 1.1.1.1 interns

articles.summary: Quick Tunnels now support email authentication. Add --allowed-mail to one cloudflared command, and only the addresses or domains you list can reach your local app. No Cloudflare account required on either side.
articles.title: Protected Quick Tunnels: simple accountless authentication for your next dev project

articles.summary: AI sovereignty is not a zero-sum game, but many governments now believe it is. Cloudflare's answer: more local open-source models, model-agnostic security tools, and a commitment to giving nations genuine choice.
articles.title: One year later: Sovereign AI and the fight for choice

articles.summary: When strikes hit Yandex data centers, many assumed Russian bot operations went dark. Cloudflare data reveals that while search crawling stopped, malicious bots simply migrated to other networks.
articles.title: Yandex outage: Data shows that instead of going dark, malicious bots went on the move

articles.summary: Fraudsters are increasingly using AI to bypass stateless security checks. Cloudflare's new Account Abuse Protection dashboard uses stateful analysis and edge-generated Hashed User IDs to help teams investigate and block account abuse.
articles.title: Follow the thread: a new dashboard to investigate account abuse

articles.summary: While adding MySQL support to Hyperdrive, we found a subtle protocol bug when caching query results.
articles.title: Inside Hyperdrive: How we solved a rare Hyperdrive MySQL caching bug

articles.summary: Workers KV Instant delivers sub-2ms p99 read latencies and 250ms global replication across Cloudflare’s 300+ edge locations. KV Instant eliminates cold-read penalties and uses the familiar Workers KV API.
articles.title: Introducing Workers KV Instant — powered by Quicksilver

articles.summary: Logpush now supports Transformers, allowing teams to filter, redact, and reshape log streams using SQL before export.
articles.title: Filter, reshape, and redact logs before export with Transformers

articles.summary: Cloudflare Traces shows how a request moves through security rules, transformations, cache, routing, Workers, and your origin, then follows it across services running anywhere in your stack.
articles.title: Introducing Cloudflare Traces: follow requests through our entire platform

articles.summary: Cloudflare now ranks as the fastest provider across 74% of the top 1,000 global networks. By incorporating background telemetry from Cloudflare Challenge Pages, we have expanded our real-user measurement scale while maintaining user privacy.
articles.title: 2026 Birthday week: network performance update

articles.summary: Cloudflare is launching eight major updates that bring logs, traces, analytics, alerts, dashboards, querying, and telemetry export into one observability platform, with simpler and more predictable pricing.
articles.title: 8 major updates to Cloudflare Observability

articles.summary: Our strategies to optimize our data pipeline throughput without compromising data quality.
articles.title: Rewinding the exponential: How we keep hardware usage down

articles.summary: AI Search is now generally available. It embeds image pixels directly for visual search, runs optical character recognition on scanned PDFs, accepts files up to 10 MiB, and works with any chat model. Here's what's new and how pricing works.
articles.title: AI Search is now generally available

articles.summary: Cloudflare AI Gateway now supports native web search API integration in partnership with Ceramic.ai, Exa, and Linkup. Developers can now inject real-time web context into model inference calls via AI Gateway, REST APIs, or Workers bindings.
articles.title: Introducing Web Search API via AI Gateway

articles.summary: Cloudflare K2 is a serverless event streaming service built directly on top of R2 object storage for high-scale data movement and long-term retention. By decoupling producers and consumers at the edge, K2 enables durable, ordered log streams without the operational overhead of traditional broker clusters.
articles.title: Announcing Cloudflare K2: serverless event streams

articles.summary: The Deno team is joining Cloudflare to radically simplify self-hosting Workers and Durable Objects, so developers can use the same primitives in more places.
articles.title: Deno is joining Cloudflare

articles.summary: We celebrated our 16th birthday with 46 announcements across open source, post-quantum security, AI agents, and developer platform upgrades. Here’s a day-by-day roundup of everything we shipped.
articles.title: Everything we launched during Birthday Week 2026

articles.summary: A year after pledging to eliminate two-tier product access, Cloudflare has expanded Logpush, multi-account governance, and higher platform limits to all accounts. Here is an update on our progress, how we dogfood these tools internally, and what is coming next.
articles.title: Updates on our pledge to make Cloudflare features accessible to everyone

articles.summary: Basin gives any team the tools to collect, store, and analyze data at scale without dedicated servers, vendor lock-in, or fees to move data between clouds.
articles.title: Cloudflare Launches Basin: A More Open and Accessible Data Platform for Developers

articles.summary: We are expanding the Clef decision model family with Clef-omni, natively processing audio, video, images, and text in a single pipeline.
articles.title: Introducing Clef-omni with full multimodality, plus a faster Clef and a cheaper Clef-flash

articles.summary: Some of the world's leading organizations are building the future of non-profit work with Cloudflare.
articles.title: Building for good: How civil society organizations are automating on Cloudflare

articles.summary: A deep dive into how D1 architected its control plane to scale and manage millions of databases, while keeping data plane query operations at the edge. We share guiding principles on how to build on the Developer Platform effectively.
articles.title: Under the hood, off the hot path: How D1 scales to millions of databases

articles.summary: On-demand CPU and memory profiling for Cloudflare Workers and Durable Objects is now available. Now you can generate interactive flamegraphs directly in production to quickly track down memory leaks and performance bottlenecks.
articles.title: Introducing on-demand CPU and memory profiling with flamegraphs for Workers and Durable Objects

articles.summary: Cloudflare is hosting a competition to see who will build the next Git platform for an era of AI agents. Artifacts is in open beta, with Workers bindings, data jurisdiction controls, and event subscriptions for repository changes.
articles.title: We want you to build the next Git platform on Cloudflare

articles.summary: On October 11, 2026, the DNS root switches to a new key-signing key (KSK-2024). Learn what this means for you, and how RFC 8509 trust anchor sentinels allow you to test whether your DNS resolver is ready for the rollover.
articles.title: The keys to the Internet change on October 11. Are you ready?

articles.summary: Streamline demonstrates how to build long-running, continuous video processing pipelines by pairing Cloudflare Workers and Durable Objects with a containerized media engine.
articles.title: Streamline: custom video pipelines with Cloudflare Stream and Workers

articles.summary: We’re announcing the closed beta of a self-serve Cloudflare OHTTP Gateway. We’re also renaming our Privacy Gateway to Cloudflare OHTTP Relay to better distinguish the two products.
articles.title: Announcing Cloudflare OHTTP Gateway – expanding access to Cloudflare’s privacy-preserving infrastructure

articles.summary: Cloudflare Managed Defense uses a team of specialized AI agents built on Workers and global network telemetry to analyze security alerts. By separating deterministic evidence collection from model inference, the system delivers grounded recommendations to Managed Defense Analysts.
articles.title: Building an evidence-grounded agentic security operations harness on Cloudflare
